statement.p: If C is the curve given by \mathbf{r} \left( t \right) = \left( 1 + 5 \sin t \right) \mathbf{i} + \left( 1 + 2 \sin^{2} t \right) \mathbf{j} + \left( 1 + 5 \sin^{3} t \right) \mathbf{k}, 0 \leq t \leq \frac{\pi}{2} and F is the radial vector field \mathbf{F} \left( x, y, z \right) = x \mathbf{i} + y \mathbf{j} + z \mathbf{k}, compute the work done by F on a particle moving along C.
